query:
INSERT INTO matches (kind, state, home, away, rule_set, rules, rules_hash,
                              home_ready_at, away_ready_at, tournament_set_id)
         VALUES ('test', 'accepted', $1, $2, $3, $4, $5,
                 CASE WHEN $6 THEN now() END, CASE WHEN $7 THEN now() END, $8)
         RETURNING match_id
